alt: 學生用放大鏡與鑷子仔細調整稿紙上的細小紙條，桌上堆滿廢紙條，同伴指著圖畫書中仍空白的一頁。
scene_prompt: At a modern writing workshop, one older student peers through a magnifying glass at the spacing between two tiny, entirely blank paper strips on a manuscript page, carefully adjusting one strip with tweezers. Their intense fussy expression and large pile of discarded blank strips show excessive attention to minuscule phrasing details. In front of them, a younger classmate patiently points to the much larger unfinished picture-book spread showing a simple rescue scene whose central page is still empty, and the wall clock has no numbers. Convey a wordsmith obsessing over tiny wording while the main communication remains unfinished. All pages have only blank gray blocks and tiny abstract unlettered dots; no actual writing, letters, invented script, or mouths biting paper. Two people only.
